premises.text: Furniture shopping is high risk because buyers cannot see how items will look in their own home; existing 3D tools are too hard, expensive, or slow for homeowners (<1% use)
Inside Maps lets anyone create a home 3D model with a smartphone by guided wall photos plus IMU data, then place catalog furniture, measure, collaborate with sticky notes, and share browser links
premises.evidence_span: the only homeowner-friendly solution that allows anyone to create a 3D model of their own home with just a smartphone

premises.text: Multi-image point clouds processed in minutes on GPU cloud detect structure and render photorealistic WebGL models including color/texture/materials
premises.evidence_span: we're able to do this in a few minutes using GPU compute power on the cloud

premises.text: Business connects retailers with homeowners so retailers upsell, reach new customers, and lower returns
premises.evidence_span: Our business opportunity is to connect retailers with homeowners

value.text: Home becomes the ultimate showroom so people can shop furniture confidently seeing items in their own space
value.evidence_span: your home becomes the ultimate showroom, that your home becomes the ideal place to shop for furniture

causal_links.evidence_span: hard to see how something that you choose online or even in a retail store will look in your own home
takes a sofa from the Crate and Barrel catalog and puts it in her living room

notes: Hard/expensive/slow commercial 3D tools folded into the homeowner problem (§4.1.6). Capture, place furniture, measure, design boards, email/sticky collaboration folded as app cascade (§4.1.7); photoreal GPU reconstruction kept as enabling tech of that model. Top-10 retailer deal treated as traction evidence for retailer GTM premise. $50B market framing excluded. Three domains; not a need/product/money triad.
